library demo;
part 'demo.g.dart';
export 'src/a.dart' hide Secret;
import 'a.dart' deferred as lazy;

sealed class Expr {}
final class Num extends Expr { Num(this.v); final num v; }
base class Add extends Expr { Add(this.l, this.r); final Expr l, r; }

num eval(Expr e) => switch (e) {
      Num(:final v) => v,
      Add(l: var a, r: var b) when a != null => eval(a) + eval(b),
      _ => throw UnsupportedError('no \$ $e'),
    };

typedef Pair<A, B> = (A, B);

void records() {
  var (a, b) = (1, 'two');
  final named = (x: 1, y: 2);
  print('${named.x + named.y} and ${"nested ${a}"}');
  if (a case int n when n > 0) print(n);
  const list = <int>[1, 2, ...[3, 4], if (a > 0) 5, for (var i in [6]) i];
  final set = {1, 2}, map = {'k': 1, ...{'j': 2}};
  var s = 'it\'s' "say \"hi\"" r'\raw' '''multi
line ${a}''';
  assert(a is! String, 'msg');
  a ??= 3; b ??= 'x';
  late final int z = 10 ~/ 3;
  x?.y?.z!.w;
  label: for (;;) { break label; }
  try { throw Exception('e'); } on FormatException catch (e, st) { rethrow; } finally {}
}

abstract interface class Repo<T> { Future<T?> find(int id); }
mixin class Both {}
extension NumX<T extends num> on T { T get twice => this * 2 as T; }
